name: Environmental Sustainability Commission Special Meeting - Comprehensive Environmental Sustainability Plan
agenda_text:
CITY  OF  ALHAMBRA

  NOTICE OF SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE
  ENVIRONMENTAL SUSTAINABILITY COMMISSION
  (Notice No. N2M24-11)

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the City of Alhambra will be hosting a virtual
workshop to welcome stakeholders for the development of the City’s Comprehensive
Environmental Sustainability Plan on Thursday, January 25, 2024, at 2:00 p.m. on the
topic of Environment, Energy, and Climate, with meeting registration via Zoom at
https://kearnswest.zoom.us/j/86124816135.

It is intended that this virtual meeting shall be led by the City’s Consultants
Environmental Science Associates and Kearns & West. However, due to the possibility
that three (3) or more members of the Environmental Sustainability Commission may
attend this meeting, which will include a discussion of priority environmental action
items that should be considered for Alhambra, notice of a special meeting of the
Alhambra Environmental Sustainability Commission is hereby given.

  LUCY GARCIA, ASSISTANT CITY MANAGER

Dated: January 23, 2024
Notice No. N2M24-11
